title: Access review: emergency access
purpose: See each use of emergency access, who used it, on which ticket and why, and which uses wait for a review. For holders of the review capability only.
summary: Every use of emergency access, newest first: who used it, on which ticket, why, when it started, and whether it is in force, waiting for review or reviewed.

tasks.title: Find the uses that wait for a review
steps: Choose Waiting for review in [[Status]] and select [[Show]].
Select a use's number, such as EA-000001, to open it and record your review there.

tasks.title: Check who has emergency access now
steps: Choose In force in [[Status]] and select [[Show]]. The time under the status is when the use ends.

tasks.title: See every use
steps: Choose Any status in [[Status]] and select [[Show]].

good_to_know: A use is listed as soon as it starts. It can be reviewed only once it has ended, and only by someone other than the person who used it.
Nobody can use emergency access until a superuser gives Can use emergency access to someone, so the tab stays empty until then.
A use and its review cannot be changed or removed, by you or anyone else.
Each page you open here is recorded, and other reviewers see it under Workspace use in [[Audit review]].

sections.title: The Emergency access tab
paragraphs: The fourth tab of Access review, after Accounts, Unused accounts and Reviews. A use of emergency access is one start by a member of staff who holds Can use emergency access and cannot view patient information: for 60 minutes from its start they could reveal the patient-marked answers and the person-level key of one ticket they may read. Each use waits here until someone other than the person who used it records a review on its page.

Nothing on this tab changes an account or a ticket. To take emergency access away from someone, a superuser removes Can use emergency access on the account's page in the admin console, which also stops at once what a use in force gives; the use is still listed as In force until its end.

items.label: Waiting for review notice
items.description: A notice above the table while at least one use has ended without a review: how many, counted when the page opens, whatever the status chosen.

items.label: Status
items.description: Any status, In force, Waiting for review or Reviewed. Show applies it.

items.label: Use
items.description: The use's number, such as EA-000001. Select it to open the use's page.

items.label: Person
items.description: The name of the person who used it, with their roles below, as they stood when they started.

items.label: Ticket
items.description: The ticket's number, as text. Open the use to reach the ticket, when you may read it.

items.label: Reason
items.description: The reason the person chose: Reporting a critical or urgent result, An urgent request from someone treating the patient, An urgent problem identifying a sample or a patient, or Another emergency. Their explanation is on the use's page.

items.label: Started
items.description: The date and time it started, in the laboratory's time zone, by the database's clock.

items.label: In force
items.description: Its end has not passed by the database's clock when the page opens. The time below is when it ends. It cannot be reviewed yet.

items.label: Waiting for review
items.description: It has ended and nobody has recorded a review.

items.label: Reviewed
items.description: A review is recorded, with its outcome below: Appropriate, or Not appropriate: follow-up needed.

items.label: Pages
items.description: Fifty uses per page, newest first. Every page lists the uses as they stood when the first page opened, so a use started since does not move a row; open the tab again from the menu to see it. A use whose start was still being saved when the first page opened can still appear on a later page. The status of each use is read again on each page.

items.label: No emergency access used yet
items.description: Shown instead of the table until someone starts emergency access.

items.label: No use has this status
items.description: Shown when uses exist but none has the status chosen. Choose Any status to see every use.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: Shown instead of the table when the address names a status that is not in the list. Nothing is listed until you choose a status from [[Status]]; the page is recorded under Workspace use as a filter that was not accepted.

sections.title: Who can use this page
paragraphs: Staff with a laboratory role who hold the capability Can review access and audit records, as for the rest of Access review. A supervisor or the admin role without it is refused, and so are client portal accounts.

Each page of this list is recorded under Workspace use in Audit review, with the source Access review: emergency access and how many uses were listed. If the record cannot be written, nothing is shown.
